# CI/CD Tools and Practices Final Project GitHub Action Workflows

This directory will contain all the GitHub Action workflows you create in the CI/CD Tools and Practices Final Project.

This repo got GitHub Action Workflows for:
  push on main
  pull_request on main

It will trigger a pipeline which is going to:
  Lint with Flake8
  Test with nose

It also contains Tekton Tasks:
  cleanup (So every pipeline is fresh)
  Nose (for testing)
